start: Owner; several members owe money, some for more than a month

user_sees: 'All money still due to the gym' under the title
Tile 'Total due' with '<n> members', and one tile per age group with its amount and number of unpaid memberships
'Who has dues' with chips 'All <n>' and one per age group, each with the number of people in it
must_not: A chip count that differs from the rows it shows
An archived member's due left out of 'Total due'

user_sees: Only those people; 'Total due' now shows their sum with '<k> of <n> members shown'
must_not: 'Total due' still showing everyone above a shorter list

user_sees: The collect-payment sheet for that member (its fields are another feature)
must_not: The sheet opening for another member
An amount of zero when dues exist

user_sees: A note 'Payment saved.'
The member's due is smaller, or the member leaves the list when fully paid; tiles and chips follow
must_not: The old due still listed
Two payments from a double tap

start: Dues tab; the owner wants the list for the accountant (the export)

steps.action: Pick an age group, then tap 'Download Excel file'
user_sees: A file named with the gym, 'dues' and today's date
Columns 'Member', 'Mobile', 'Batch', 'Membership', 'PT sessions used', 'Trainer', 'Started', 'Days due', 'Age', 'Amount due (INR)', 'Archived'
A note 'Exported <n> dues.'
must_not: Dues in the file that the picked age group does not show
An amount column that does not add up to 'Total due'

start: Dues tab in its empty and broken cases

steps.action: Open 'Dues' when every membership is paid
user_sees: 'No dues' with 'Every membership is fully paid.' and a button 'Open Members'
must_not: Tiles full of zeros
A member with a zero-price plan listed

steps.action: Tap an age-group chip with nobody in it
user_sees: 'Nothing in this age group'
must_not: 'No dues'

steps.action: Tap 'Collect' for a member whose record cannot be found
user_sees: A red line 'That member could not be opened. Try reloading the page.'
must_not: An empty collect sheet

start: A member owes for two memberships

user_sees: The member once, in the age group of the older due, with both amounts added
A line 'A member with more than one unpaid membership is listed once, in the group of the oldest one.'
must_not: The member twice

user_sees: Still listed with what is left
must_not: Shown as fully paid

steps.action: Cancel that receipt in Collections and come back
user_sees: The full due again
must_not: The due lost

user_sees: Still listed, with a pill 'Archived'
must_not: The due dropping off the list and the total

start: The gym has pass members (FITPASS, cultpass) and normal members

user_sees: Only members with an unpaid membership
must_not: A pass member shown as owing
A member of another branch

start: Front desk signed in; a member who owes fees is at the desk

user_sees: Title 'Money' with 'Who still has fees to pay'
No tabs: the dues list straight away
'Who has dues' with the age chips and, per person, their own amount and a 'Collect' button
must_not: 'Total due' or any age tile with gym money
'Download Excel file'
A 'Collections' tab

steps.action: Tap 'Collect' on the member and save the payment
user_sees: A note 'Payment saved.'; the member's due shrinks or the member leaves the list
must_not: A double payment
The amount landing on another member

start: Front desk tries to reach the owner's money pages

user_sees: The dues list, same as before
must_not: Collections, totals, charts or the export

user_sees: 'No dues' with 'Every membership is fully paid.' and 'Open Members'
must_not: A blank page

start: Front desk; a member pays half now and the rest next week

user_sees: The member still listed with the remaining half
must_not: The member gone from the list

steps.action: A week later collect the rest
user_sees: The member leaves the list; the chip counts drop by one
must_not: An old count on the chips

start: Front desk on a shared screen at the counter

user_sees: Each person's own due, name and age of the due
must_not: The gym's total due, collections, or a file with every member's mobile number
Dues of another gym
